items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: NTG was the initials of a production company around town that put shows on.

ctx.x: Yes, I believe I mentioned the Cab Calloway Orchestra. I'm not sure, right off the top of my head, whether Ellington came in there or not. I know he came into the vicinity many times and played theaters and such. But I'm not sure whether he came in Sebastian's, but after that, the Les Height Band was also out of there, during the time that -- NTG was the initials of a production company around town that put shows on.
